correctness.rationale: Independently checked original Definition 2.1 and 3.4 and Corollary 3.8 against the 9-page publisher PDF. Let R=T_C U*. Since A is invertible, ||I-RA||<1 implies RA and then R invertible, and A=R^-1 gives zero defect. C=I, H=C, f1=1, g1=3, A=I/3 give R=UT_C*=3I; fixed approximate defect is |1-3|=2, refuting Corollary 3.8(iii). Neumann terms in Corollary 3.8(i) are (-2)^n g1 and diverge; the inverse (UT_C*)^-1 g1 =1 and the valid dual-pair portion remain intact. The source proof of (iii) tests ||I-RA|| when Theorem 3.7 needs ||I-R||. No finite experiment used as an infinite proof.
